basic_info.description: This two story single family home in the Outer Sunset District boasts four bedrooms and two baths with over 1500 sft of living space. Two bedrooms and one bath are upstairs and two bedrooms and bath downstairs off the one car garage. Potential for an ADU conversion. Exterior has been recently painted and a new roof was completed in 2023. Steps to Ocean Beach to enjoy a beach stroll, or walk to the SF Zoo or Golden Gate Park. Tenant occupied. DO NOT disturb tenants. By appointment only. Subject to cancelation of current escrow.
